integrity: All nonzero coefficient masks, projective-chart Jacobian ideals and Fano-plane incidences were enumerated exactly. Independent 512-splitting cross-check reproduces all eight nets. No independent external review is represented.
scientific_limitations: Exactly eight three-dimensional vector subspaces of binary ternary cubics have all seven rational members smooth and tangent-filling, but the assertion does not require all geometric members of the nets to be smooth. Classification concerns embedded projective equivalence, not abstract elliptic-curve classes. External publication priority may depend on unindexed older finite-geometry catalogues.
title: Eight Singer nets of smooth tangent-filling binary plane cubics
